D001.name: Attention-Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder (Combined Presentation)
D001.note: KG tests the three ADHD presentations (D001/D002/D003) as distinct diagnoses, so their code sets are kept mutually exclusive — no cross-acceptance between subtypes. F90.8 (other type) and F90.9 (unspecified type) are deliberately excluded from all three: they don't specify which presentation, so assigning them to any one subtype would be a guess.

D002.name: Attention-Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder (Predominantly Inattentive Presentation)
D002.icd10_name: Attention-deficit hyperactivity disorder, predominantly inattentive type

D003.name: Attention-Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder (Predominantly Hyperactive/Impulsive Presentation)
D003.icd10_name: Attention-deficit hyperactivity disorder, predominantly hyperactive type

D004.name: Delusional Disorder
D004.note: KG doesn't subtype Delusional Disorder, so both F22.0 (delusional disorder) and F22.8 (other persistent delusional disorders) are accepted alongside the bare category code.

D005.name: Schizophrenia
D005.note: KG doesn't subtype Schizophrenia, so all ICD-10-CM F20.x clinical subtypes (paranoid, disorganized, catatonic, undifferentiated, residual, simple, other) are accepted. F20.81 (schizophreniform disorder) is deliberately excluded — it's a distinct, shorter-duration diagnosis, not a Schizophrenia subtype.

D006.name: Schizoaffective Disorder (Bipolar Type)
D006.note: KG splits Schizoaffective Disorder by mood type (D006 bipolar / D007 depressive), so codes stay mutually exclusive. F25.8 (other) and F25.9 (unspecified) are deliberately excluded from both — they don't indicate which mood type, so assigning them to either subtype would be a guess.

D008.name: Bipolar I Disorder
D008.note: Covers every Bipolar I current/most-recent-episode code (hypomanic, manic, depressed, mixed, in remission, other) at every DSM-5 severity level, EXCLUDING the psychotic-features codes (F31.2, F31.5, F31.64 — reserved for D010) and F31.81 (Bipolar II — reserved for D009). Remission codes (F31.7x) don't carry a psychotic-features specifier in ICD-10-CM, so they're assigned here as the more inclusive default rather than to D010.

D010.name: Bipolar I Disorder with Psychotic Features
D010.icd10_name: Bipolar disorder, current episode manic severe with psychotic features
D010.note: All three Bipolar I codes that explicitly carry a 'with psychotic features' specifier: F31.2 (manic, severe, with psychotic features), F31.5 (depressed, severe, with psychotic features), F31.64 (mixed, severe, with psychotic features).

D012.name: Specific Phobia
D012.note: KG doesn't subtype Specific Phobia, so every DSM-5-TR subtype code is accepted: animal (F40.218), natural environment (F40.228), blood/injection/transfusion/injury (F40.230-F40.233), situational (F40.248), and other (F40.298) — plus the bare F40.2 category and the F40.9 generic default models sometimes fall back to.

D013.name: Major Depressive Disorder
D013.icd10_name: Major depressive disorder, single episode, unspecified
D013.note: KG doesn't test single-vs-recurrent episode count as a diagnostic criterion, so both F32.x (single episode) and F33.x (recurrent) non-psychotic severity/remission codes are accepted. Severe-with-psychotic-features codes (F32.3, F33.3) are excluded — reserved for D015.

D015.name: Major Depressive Disorder with Psychotic Features
D015.icd10_name: Major depressive disorder, single episode, severe with psychotic features
D015.note: Both the single-episode (F32.3) and recurrent (F33.3) severe-with-psychotic-features codes, for the same reason D013 accepts both episode counts.

D016.name: Obsessive-Compulsive Disorder
D016.note: F42.3 (hoarding disorder) and F42.4 (excoriation disorder) share OCD's F42 parent category in ICD-10-CM but are distinct DSM-5 diagnoses, not OCD subtypes — deliberately excluded rather than accepted as OCD matches.

D017.name: Body Dysmorphic Disorder
D017.note: F45.2 is the shared ICD-10 parent for both BDD (F45.22) and illness anxiety disorder/hypochondriasis (F45.21); the bare parent is accepted as a plausible under-specified match, but F45.21 itself is excluded since it names a different diagnosis.

D018.name: Posttraumatic Stress Disorder
D018.note: Includes acute (F43.11) and chronic (F43.12) PTSD alongside the unspecified code and the bare F43.1 category — KG doesn't test acute-vs-chronic course as a diagnostic criterion.

D020.name: Adjustment Disorder
D020.note: KG doesn't subtype Adjustment Disorder, so every DSM-5 specifier (with depressed mood, with anxiety, with mixed anxiety and depressed mood, with disturbance of conduct, with mixed disturbance of emotions and conduct, with other symptoms) is accepted alongside the bare category and unspecified codes.

D021.name: Anorexia Nervosa
D021.note: KG doesn't subtype Anorexia Nervosa, so both restricting (F50.01) and binge-eating/purging (F50.02) types are accepted alongside the bare category and unspecified codes.

D023.name: Binge-Eating Disorder
D023.note: F50.8 was binge-eating disorder's code before DSM-5-TR (2022) introduced the dedicated F50.81 — both are accepted since models trained on either convention use them interchangeably.
